newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Hunter Douglas reiterates optimism for 97.
newsitem.headline: Hunter Douglas reiterates optimism for 97.

text.p: Window blinds maker Hunter Douglas said on Tuesday that its first quarter results confirmed its upbeat outlook for the full year.
"The first quarter results confirm the Group's previously expressed optimistic outlook for the full year," Hunter Douglas said in a statement.
The company reported first quarter sales rose 13.4 percent to 570 million guilders from a year-earlier 503.0 million.
Net profits rose 19.8 percent year-on-year to 30.3 million guilders.
Hunter Douglas said in March it was optimistic for 1997, given its strong performance in North America, Asia and Latin America and an expected pick-up in its European and Australian business.
